entries.text_de:
Edinburgh Advocates' library6 28. 4. 8, Papier, Abschriften eines Cambridger Rechtshistorikers [Ende7] 16. Jhs. Schmutzblatt: Liste der Gesetzgeber Englands. Über Gründung Cambridge's a. mundi 318.

f. 1 Epistola Euleutherii, d. i. Interpolation der Leges Angl Lond in ECf retr 11, 1 B, u. S. 636.

f. 2 Gesetzgebung durch Eadward den Bek., Molmutius, Marcia [aus Galfrid von Monmouth II 17. III 13], Ine; Denelaga, Liste der Grafschaften; f. 3 Braughth: Huiusmodi uero leges Anglicane [d. i. Bracton I 2, 7 f. 1b]; f. 3b Soc, hec est secta de hominibus [!]; sac . . toll and team, infangethef; f. 5—10 Exposiciones8 quorundam Saxonicorum vocabulorum; f. 11—13 leer.

f. 14 Ine, u. S. 89, und zwar die Form Bromton's, wie auch f. 15 vermerkt: Hoc exemplar transcriptum e libro Jorevallensis historie [d. i. oben Brco]; sed correctio e libris Latinis aliis, ut ex libro Brat [Bracton?], e libro paruo meo nigro et ex ipso Saxonico contextu; f. 19 Af aus Br, mit dessen eigenen Worten u. S. 472; f. 20 Incipiunt leges quas rex Ælfredus de Veteri Testamento, u. S. 27, Copie aus Co's Nachtrag9; f. 28b App. AGu, u. S. 394, Überschrift aus Br, Marginalie über Edward I. (S. 394†††) aus Co; Blatt zwischen f. 28 und 29 AGu, u. S. 127, aus Co; f. 29b EGu, u. S. 129, aus Br; f. 30b I. II Ew aus Br, u. S. 139. Zu f. 31 ist ein Blatt eingeschoben aus Leges Angl. Lond. coll., nämlich Pseudo-Af10 bis coronatus a Leone papa, wohl aus Co; f. 32 I As, u. S. 147 aus Br; f. 35b Hu, u. S. 192, aus Br; f. 36 Norðleod, Að, Had, u. S. 459—465, alles aus Br; f. 39 eingeschoben III As, u. S. 170; f. 43 I Em, u. S. 185, aus Br; f. 45 endet (welches Gesetz?) Em; f. 45 II. III Eg, u. S. 195 aus Br; f. 46b I Atr, u. S. 217 aus Br; andere Atr; f. 54 Prologus super . . Knut. Post pacificacionem11 aus Co; f. 55 Hec sunt instituta Kanuti, I. II Cn, u. S. 279, aus Co; f. 66v. endet Cn; 67 ff. leer; f. 70 Wl lad aus Quadr., u. S. 483. Anno 1083 . . rex Willelmus misit iusticiarios, Citat aus Wilhelm von Malmesbury. f. 71 Wl art Lond retr, u. S. 489, wohl aus Co. p. 131 Transcriptum veteri libro Wigorn., in quo continentur leges R. de Glanvilla et H. Bracton [d. h. aus Wo] ECf, u. S. 661 Ed 1 genannt12, wie Wo in 34, 1a endend, p. 140. Ein zweiter Schreiber, Ed 2, fügt hinzu ECf 34, 1a—35, 2 aus einem Hk gleichen Texte.
entries.text_en:
Edinburgh, Advocates' Library6 28. 4. 8, paper, transcripts by a Cambridge legal historian [end7] of the 16th century. Flyleaf: list of the lawgivers of England. On the founding of Cambridge a. mundi 318.

f. 1 Epistola Euleutherii, i.e. the interpolation of the Leges Angl Lond in ECf retr 11, 1 B, below, p. 636.

f. 2 Legislation by Edward the Confessor, Molmutius, Marcia [from Geoffrey of Monmouth II 17. III 13], Ine; Denelaga, list of the shires; f. 3 Braughth: Huiusmodi uero leges Anglicane [i.e. Bracton I 2, 7 f. 1b]; f. 3b Soc, hec est secta de hominibus [!]; sac . . toll and team, infangethef; ff. 5—10 Exposiciones8 quorundam Saxonicorum vocabulorum; ff. 11—13 blank.

f. 14 Ine, below, p. 89, and indeed in Bromton's form, as f. 15 also notes: Hoc exemplar transcriptum e libro Jorevallensis historie [i.e. Brco above]; sed correctio e libris Latinis aliis, ut ex libro Brat [Bracton?], e libro paruo meo nigro et ex ipso Saxonico contextu; f. 19 Af from Br, with Br's own words, below, p. 472; f. 20 Incipiunt leges quas rex Ælfredus de Veteri Testamento, below, p. 27, a copy from Co's addition9; f. 28b App. AGu, below, p. 394, heading from Br, marginal note on Edward I (p. 394†††) from Co; leaf between ff. 28 and 29 AGu, below, p. 127, from Co; f. 29b EGu, below, p. 129, from Br; f. 30b I. II Ew from Br, below, p. 139. At f. 31 a leaf is inserted from the Leges Angl. Lond. coll., namely Pseudo-Af10 as far as coronatus a Leone papa, probably from Co; f. 32 I As, below, p. 147, from Br; f. 35b Hu, below, p. 192, from Br; f. 36 Norðleod, Að, Had, below, pp. 459—465, all from Br; f. 39 inserted III As, below, p. 170; f. 43 I Em, below, p. 185, from Br; f. 45 ends (which law?) Em; f. 45 II. III Eg, below, p. 195, from Br; f. 46b I Atr, below, p. 217, from Br; other Atr; f. 54 Prologus super . . Knut. Post pacificacionem11 from Co; f. 55 Hec sunt instituta Kanuti, I. II Cn, below, p. 279, from Co; f. 66v. Cn ends; ff. 67 ff. blank; f. 70 Wl lad from Quadr., below, p. 483. Anno 1083 . . rex Willelmus misit iusticiarios, a quotation from William of Malmesbury. f. 71 Wl art Lond retr, below, p. 489, probably from Co. p. 131 Transcriptum veteri libro Wigorn., in quo continentur leges R. de Glanvilla et H. Bracton [i.e. from Wo] ECf, below, p. 661, called Ed 112, ending like Wo at 34, 1a, p. 140. A second scribe, Ed 2, adds ECf 34, 1a—35, 2 from an Hk text of the same kind.

notes.text_de: Freundl. Mitth. von Prof. G. W. Prothero, 12. Jan. 1896.
notes.text_en: Kind communication from Prof. G. W. Prothero, 12 Jan. 1896.

notes.text_de: Nicht früher lagen Co und Brco in Cambridge.
notes.text_en: Co and Brco were not in Cambridge earlier.

notes.text_de: vgl. Hall Red book of the Exchequer p. ccclvi.
notes.text_en: cf. Hall, Red book of the Exchequer p. ccclvi.

transcription.doubts: Heading at foot of col. 1, p. xxiv; text runs on into col. 2. '47<sup>2</sup>' is a page-and-note reference. A stray mark after 'oben' in '[d. i. oben Brco]' is broken type, omitted. 'Euleutherii' as printed. 'ECf 34, 1a—35, 2' at the end is roman (checked). 'ccclvi' small capitals.
proof_notes: n. 12: 'Über Leges ECf' → 'Über Leges ECf.' (period printed, p. xxiv)
